data.jobspec:
#!/usr/bin/bash
#FLUX --job-name=chienlab-tnseq-ba   # Job name
#FLUX --queue=cpu            # Partition (queue) name
#FLUX --ntasks=24                   # Number of CPU cores
#FLUX --nodes=1                       # Number of nodes
#FLUX --mem=240gb                     # Job memory request
#FLUX --time=06:00:00               # Time limit hrs:min:sec
#FLUX --output=logs/chienlab-tnseq-ba_{id}.log   # Standard output and error log
date;hostname;pwd

# Load modules

module load miniconda/22.11.1-1

# Activate conda environment

conda activate /work/pi_pchien_umass_edu/berent/chienlab-tnseq/conda-tnseq

# Run pipeline with all available cores
# The Snakemake '--cores' argument will use all cores available to the job.
# The job requests 24 tasks, so Snakemake will use 24 cores.
snakemake -q rules --profile profiles/default --cores

date
